description: This Java source file defines a ContentProvider class 'WeatherDataProvider' that manages in-memory weather data points for a weather widget. It includes a data class 'WeatherDataPoint' and handles initialization, querying, updating, and standard ContentProvider operations for weather data represented as days and temperatures.

classes.name: WeatherDataPoint
classes.description: A simple data class representing a weather data point with a day (String) and temperature (int).

classes.name: WeatherDataProvider
classes.description: A ContentProvider subclass managing in-memory weather data, used by the weather widget to supply weather information.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the provider with sample weather data for each day of the week.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Returns a Cursor over all weather data points, with columns for ID, day, and temperature.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for the data provided by this ContentProvider.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Method stub; not supported in this sample implementation.

methods.description: Method stub; not supported in this sample implementation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the temperature value for a specific weather data point identified by URI segment, and notifies observers of data change.
